title: The Dirty shirt from the trip
subtitle: 循环利用 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 循环利用（人与自然·环境保护·循环利用与节约）
meta: 主题语境：循环利用（人与自然·环境保护·循环利用与节约）　|　核心词汇：dirty　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 dirty 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 the craftsman wrote of ① a dirty shirt from the trip in the ledger, and everybody in the workshop said at once that it was ② dirtier than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the craftsman, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the dirty ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the dirtiest shirt from the trip anybody in the workshop had ever seen, or so the ledger for August 1986 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too dirty to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the apprentice who had come to help; the dirty ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tool at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a dirty trick with the money, and said that no apprentice in his right mind would call it ⑥ as dirty as the trick with the money they had once had in the old workshop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was dirty or not, and he said so.

By 1999 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something dirty, and nothing besides. The apprentice from the next workshop called the whole plan ⑧ quite dirty; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the dirty ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2002, for the whole place, she wrote of another dirty shirt from the trip in the same ledger, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ dirtier than anybody had expected. ⑩ The dirtiest trick with the money in the whole workshop, she said in 2004, was the one she could never quite name; the dirty ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 肮脏（前置定语 a dirty shirt from the trip：1992 年匠人在工料簿里记下的那件肮脏的衬衫）
B. adj. 肮脏／卑劣（比较级 dirtier than：文中两处，一处比旅途后的衬衫，一处比预想）
C. adj. 肮脏／卑劣（最高级 the dirtiest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 肮脏（表语 too dirty to do：母亲觉得它太肮脏，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 卑劣（前置定语 a dirty trick with the money：叔叔把整件事称作一桩卑劣的花招）
F. adj. 卑劣（同级比较 as dirty as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩钱上的花招相比）
G. adj. 卑劣（后置定语 something dirty：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 卑劣（受程度副词修饰 quite dirty：那位学徒的评价）

items.q: a dirty shirt from the trip
the dirtiest shirt from the trip anybody
a dirty trick with the money
The dirtiest trick with the money in

answers.why: dirty 意为“肮脏”，1992 年匠人在工料簿里记下的是“一件肮脏的衬衫”，此处作前置定语 a dirty shirt from the trip。
dirty 意为“肮脏”，此处用比较级 dirtier than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
dirty 意为“肮脏”，工料簿上 八月 那行字说它是工坊里最肮脏的一件，故用最高级 the dirtiest shirt from the trip。
dirty 意为“肮脏”，母亲认为这件东西“太肮脏了，谁也用不上”，too dirty to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
dirty 意为“卑劣”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩卑劣的花招”，此处作前置定语 a dirty trick with the money。
dirty 意为“卑劣”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩钱上的花招一样卑劣”，同级比较用 as dirty as。
dirty 意为“卑劣”，工料簿上那半行字要的是“卑劣的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something dirty。
dirty 意为“卑劣”，邻工坊来的那位学徒认为这套计划“相当卑劣”，quite 修饰原级 dirty。
dirty 意为“卑劣”，2002 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要卑劣”，故用比较级 dirtier than。
dirty 意为“卑劣”，母亲 2004 年说的是“整个工坊里最卑劣的那一桩”，故用最高级 the dirtiest trick with the money。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1992 年，匠人在工料簿里记下了一件肮脏的衬衫。（a dirty shirt from the trip）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更肮脏。（dirtier than …）
母亲觉得它太肮脏，谁也用不上。（too dirty to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩卑劣的花招。（a dirty trick with the money）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩钱上的花招一样卑劣。（as dirty as …）
到了 1999 年，工料簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件卑劣的东西。（something dirty）
answers: In 1992 the craftsman wrote of a dirty shirt from the trip in the ledger.
Everybody said it was dirtier than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too dirty to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a dirty trick with the money.
He said nobody would call it as dirty as the trick with the money they had once had.
By 1999 the ledger asked for nothing but something dirty.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 dirty 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1992 the craftsman wrote of a dirty shirt from the trip in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the dirtiest shirt from the trip in the workshop, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too dirty to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a dirty trick with the money, and nobody argued with him.
The apprentice from the next workshop called the plan quite dirty, and everybody laughed.
The dirty ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
